# Import

```{r}

# ============================================== #
# import polygon

# list all shapefiles
shp_files <- list.files(
  in1,
  pattern = "\\.shp$",
  full.names = TRUE, 
  recursive = FALSE
)


# view file names
basename(shp_files)


# read all shapefiles
shp_list <- shp_files |>
  setNames(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(shp_files))) |>
  map(read_sf)



# ============================================== #
# import cleaned studyarea data
studyarea <- readr::read_csv(
  here("result", "create_leaflet_map", "studyarea_color_expanded.csv")
)
```

# Edit data

```{r}
# names(shp_list)
# names(shp_list)[1]
# plot(shp_list[[1]])

# ============================================== #
# match polygon data

studyarea_cleaned <- studyarea_color %>%
  mutate(
    index = str_replace_all(index, "<br>", ", "),
    shp = shp_list[shp_name]
  )


# ============================================== #
# combine polygons for plotting

studyarea_sf <- studyarea_cleaned %>%
  select(
    shp_name,
    realm,
    index,
    color,
    shp
  ) %>%
  pmap_dfr(
    function(
      shp_name,
      realm,
      index,
      color,
      shp
    ) {
      
      shp %>%
        mutate(
          shp_name = shp_name,
          realm = realm,
          index = index,
          color = color
        )
    }
  )



# ============================================== #
# separate by realm

studyarea_marine <- studyarea_sf %>%
  filter(realm == "marine")

studyarea_terrestrial <- studyarea_sf %>%
  filter(realm == "terrestrial") %>%
  filter(shp_name != "japan_recreate")



# use this later as text
index_wholejapan <- studyarea_cleaned %>% 
  filter(shp_name == "japan_recreate") %>% 
  pull(index)



# ============================================== #
# map extent

sf::st_bbox(studyarea_sf)

xlim_japan <- c(118, 150)
ylim_japan <- c(22, 48)






# ============================================== #
# crop to Japan

japan_ext <- terra::ext(
  c(xlim_japan, ylim_japan)
)

relief1_japan <- terra::crop(relief1, japan_ext)
relief2_japan <- terra::crop(relief2, japan_ext)
relief3_japan <- terra::crop(relief3, japan_ext)





```

# Visualize 1: use natural earth country map

```{r}



# ============================================== #
# prepare background map

world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(
  scale = 50,
  returnclass = "sf"
)



# ============================================== #
# plot

g <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = world,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = studyarea_sf,
    aes(
      fill = color,
      color = color
    ),
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_color_identity() +
  
  coord_sf(
    xlim = xlim_japan,
    ylim = ylim_japan,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  
  theme_void()

g
```



# Visualize 2: use natural earth relief map

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12

# ============================================== #
# prepare polygon labels

studyarea_label <- studyarea_sf %>%
  group_by(
    shp_name,
    index
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    geometry = sf::st_union(geometry),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  sf::st_point_on_surface() %>%
  mutate(
    point_x = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 1],
    point_y = sf::st_coordinates(.)[, 2],
    
    # initially put label at polygon location
    label_x = point_x,
    label_y = point_y
  ) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry()


# ============================================== #
# plot with automatically positioned labels

g <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_spatraster_rgb(
    data = relief1_japan,
    maxcell = 1e6
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = studyarea_sf,
    aes(
      fill = color,
      color = color
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = studyarea_label,
    aes(
      x = label_x,
      y = label_y,
      label = index
    ),
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.color = "black",
    segment.linewidth = 0.5,
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      type = "closed",
      ends = "first"
    ),
    seed = 1
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_color_identity() +
  
  coord_sf(
    xlim = xlim_japan,
    ylim = ylim_japan,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  
  theme_void()

g


# ============================================== #
# inspect coordinates before manual adjustment

studyarea_label %>%
  select(
    shp_name,
    index,
    point_x,
    point_y,
    label_x,
    label_y
  )


# ============================================== #
# manually adjusted label positions

label_manual <- tibble::tribble(
  ~shp_name, ~point_x, ~point_y, ~label_x, ~label_y,
  "e0009_koreastrait_cropped",                 125.1, 33.8, 125.1, 35.5, 
  "e0029_daisetsu",                            143.1, 44,   143.9, 45.2,
  "e0267_hakkoda",                             140.9, 40.7, 137.6, 42.0,
  "e0400_recreate",                            136.0, 34.6, 138.0, 32.3,
  "e0406_miyagi",                              140.8, 38.4, 145.3, 38.4,
  "e0434_hokkaido",                            140.0, 43.5, 146.2, 45.2,
  "e0434_hokkaido_recreate_cropped",           144.0, 43.5, 146.2, 45.2,
  "e1585_centralwesternsector_cropped",        136.1, 38.0, 136.1, 40.8,
  "e1667_eastchina_recreate_cropped",          127.9, 33.1, 125.1, 32.5,
  "e1667_pacificcoast_recreate_cropped",       133.9, 32.5, 133.9, 30.8,
  "e1991_centralwesternsector_0mbuff_cropped", 132.7, 36.8, 130.5, 36.8,
  "e2241_pacificcoast_cropped",                161.5, 43.6, 161.0, 43.6,
  "e_jgm1_easterncoast_cropped",               141.0, 35.8, 145.0, 34.5,
  "e_jgm1_westerncoast_cropped",               137.9, 37.3, 138.2, 39.6,
  "e_saito1_westjapan",                        131,   28,   134,   28,
  "e_saki1_mtfuji_recreate",                   138.7, 35.4, 145.0, 33.0,
  "j0198_rishiri",                             141.2, 45.2, 139.4, 45.2,
  "j_ogawa16_iwate",                           141.4, 39.6, 145.3, 39.9,
  "j_ogawa1_recreate",                         134.1, 33,   136.5, 30.8,
  "japan_recreate",                            140,   36,   145.0, 36.0,
  "japan_marine_recreate_cropped",             143,   33,   144.5, 30.8
)


# ============================================== #
# add manually adjusted positions

studyarea_label2 <- studyarea_label %>%
  select(
    shp_name,
    index
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    label_manual,
    by = "shp_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dx = point_x - label_x,
    dy = point_y - label_y,
    dist = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2),

    # move start of segment away from center of label
    seg_x = label_x + 0.8 * dx / dist,
    seg_y = label_y + 0.8 * dy / dist
  )


# ============================================== #
# prepare labels separately by realm

studyarea_label_marine <- studyarea_label2 %>%
  filter(
    shp_name %in% studyarea_marine$shp_name
  )

studyarea_label_terrestrial <- studyarea_label2 %>%
  filter(
    shp_name %in% studyarea_terrestrial$shp_name
  )


# ============================================== #
# function to create map

create_studyarea_map <- function(studyarea_data, label_data) {
  
  ggplot() +
    
    geom_spatraster_rgb(
      data = relief1_japan,
      maxcell = 1e6
    ) +
    
    geom_sf(
      data = studyarea_data,
      aes(
        fill = color,
        color = color
      ),
      linewidth = 1,
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    
    geom_segment(
      data = label_data,
      aes(
        x = seg_x,
        y = seg_y,
        xend = point_x,
        yend = point_y
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.4,
      color = "black",
      arrow = arrow(
        length = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        type = "closed"
      )
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = label_data,
      aes(
        x = label_x,
        y = label_y,
        label = index
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = 8,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_color_identity() +
    
    coord_sf(
      xlim = xlim_japan,
      ylim = ylim_japan,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    
    theme_void()
}


# ============================================== #
# marine map

g_marine <- create_studyarea_map(
  studyarea_data = studyarea_marine,
  label_data = studyarea_label_marine
)

g_marine


# ============================================== #
# terrestrial map

g_terrestrial <- create_studyarea_map(
  studyarea_data = studyarea_terrestrial,
  label_data = studyarea_label_terrestrial
)

g_terrestrial



# add label of whole japan as text
label_wholejapan <- str_c("Studies covering all of Japan: ", index_wholejapan)

g_terrestrial2 <- g_terrestrial +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 141,
    y = 32,
    label = label_wholejapan,
    size = 8,
    color = "black"
  )

g_terrestrial2




```
